markets.question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
markets.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Russian President Vladimir Putin remains firmly in office amid the ongoing Ukraine conflict, with no verified indications of resignation, removal, or health-related incapacity as of late August 2026. Ukrainian long-range strikes on Russian energy facilities and logistics have intensified economic pressures, including fuel shortages and refinery disruptions, while public approval has softened modestly according to state-linked polls. Putin has responded by ordering infrastructure repairs, escalating strike campaigns, and tying the ruling United Russia party explicitly to the war effort ahead of September parliamentary elections. Diplomatic contacts, including a recent CIA visit to Moscow, have not altered his rejection of compromise terms. These factors sustain trader consensus that structural controls, elite consolidation, and constitutional term extensions make near-term leadership change unlikely absent unforeseen shocks.
